metadata.coverage: Video-referenced gravel/runoff and advertising-covered safety barriers around the main straight and five corner complexes, with separately identified FIA2024 gravel strips and F1 real2024 Alboreto photograph.
metadata.method: Canonical road-relative reconstruction from game-video observations, cross-checked against dated primary real-world sources.
metadata.horizontalGeometry: Legacy main-straight source footprints have nominal15m uncertainty; new video-derived interval endpoints approximately30-60m, with widths/offsets estimated rather than surveyed.
metadata.verticalGeometry: Wall/tree bases sampled from the displayed terrain; wall heights, mesh dimensions and individual tree sizes estimated. No new road or surveyed terrain heights.
metadata.dateLimitation: F1 24 game footage uploaded2025-02-12 is not real-world capture. Separate FIA2024 notes and F1 actual2024 photo have their own dated scope; operator photo capture date unstated. This is not a2026 sponsor/facility inventory.
metadata.omitted: Unverified building changes, overhead sponsor bridges, detailed logos, and unseen runoff materials remain omitted.
metadata.advertisingRendering: Generic 5x7 vector wordmarks on sourced barrier faces. Lettering, repetition, dimensions and sponsorship epoch approximate; no downloaded sponsor/game art.
limitations: F1 24 game footage uploaded2025-02-12 is an appearance reference, not a survey or2026 real venue capture.
Actual2024 FIA changes add2.5m gravel strips at T2left and T4-T5right (the latter1m from trackedge); canonical endpoints remain estimated.
Parabolica real2024 photograph supports early outside gravel/PIRELLI and inner Workday; later asphalt runoff stays distinct. This overrides the game inner ROLEX placement locally.
Features use canonical5793m chainage, not the shared5755.94m or per-vehicle racing-line distances. Approximate endpoints30-60m and lateral widths are visual estimates.
Advertising-covered protection is represented by a solid display envelope without asserting concrete/metal/energy-absorber cores where obscured. Existing pitwall is confirmed concrete.
Original road coordinates, elevations, lane width, race/vehicle physics, timing origin and five pit/service features remain unchanged. No measured new DEM or mountain geometry.
Existing pit wall trace is migrated once to environment protection for attached lettering; it is not drawn again by pit facilities.
Gravel/asphalt/green paint are masks on the original terrain mesh, not elevated loose sheets. No new runoff physics or tyre/friction simulation is claimed.
